fixes.explanation: That's it, friend! Verse 12 says David went and had the ark of God brought up from the house of Obed-edom into the City of David with rejoicing. The report comes in and David is OUT THE DOOR. I'd have beaten him there if my base had wheels! This trip is a whole lot happier than the first one.
